title: Telepathic escape plan with cousin Ian
summary: James Fox tells of Telepathic escape plan with cousin Ian, about Fox at age 13 at San Francisco Bay Area, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: communicate he communicated to me telepathically he said on the count of

plain: James Fox, a filmmaker who makes documentaries about UFOs, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about a moment in downtown San Francisco when he was about 13. He says his cousin Ian spoke to him without words, telepathically, telling him to act on a count so they could get away together. If true, it would mean minds can talk directly to each other.
